detail.title: Information Scrambling and Record Accessibility
detail.summary: Quantum scrambling delocalizes information, potentially masking system states, yet redundant encoding via Spectrum Broadcast Structures (SBS) allows for stable, locally accessible records even in strongly scrambling quantum regimes, provided environmental coupling supports information proliferation.
